help: 101-Help: PROJECT commands:
101-Help:  PROJECT ? Help for these commands
101-Help:  PROJECT ARCHIVE - Save a project as an archive
101-Help:  PROJECT CLOSE - Close a project on the server
101-Help:  PROJECT COPY - Copy a project to a new project
101-Help:  PROJECT DELETE - Delete a project
101-Help:  PROJECT DIR - Return a list of available projects in the current repository or all the respositories.
101-Help:  PROJECT DIRFULL - Return a list of available projects on the C-Gate Server
101-Help:  PROJECT LIST - Return a list of loaded projects on the C-Gate Server
101-Help:  PROJECT LOAD - Load a project from disk
101-Help:  PROJECT NEW - Create a new blank project
101-Help:  PROJECT RENAME - Rename a project
101-Help:  PROJECT REPAIR - Repair a project
101-Help:  PROJECT RESTORE - Restore a project from an archive
101-Help:  PROJECT SAVE - Save a project to disk
101-Help:  PROJECT START - Start a project
101-Help:  PROJECT STOP - Stop a project
101 Help:  PROJECT USE - Set the current project to be used by this command session
project.repository_note: PROJECT NEW alone is not in DIRFULL; PROJECT SAVE makes the repository row visible. cmqttd's atomic JSON repository persists every modeled project immediately.
